facts.business: Paradeep Parivahan Limited operates as a logistics and transportation company with warehousing operations, and has acquired wholly-owned subsidiaries in logistics and trading sectors.
key_risks: Income tax disputes for FY 2012-13 and 2013-14 totaling Rs 1.39 crore in tax and Rs 2.26 crore in interest
Warehouse constructed on lease property with title deed not in company's name
Related party loan of Rs 4.48 crore to Gloport Enterprise Technologies Private Limited where KMP is interested
facts.related_party_note: Loan of Rs 100.00 lakhs given to Gloport Enterprise Technologies Private Limited, a party in which a Key Managerial Personnel (KMP) of the Company is interested. Outstanding balance including accrued interest is Rs 447.88 lakhs as at balance sheet date. Loan repayable in equal instalments over 10 years starting FY 2026-27 at 12% per annum interest.
